opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition fee support, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish HE institution.
opportunities.summary: Grants cover tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students, up to £1,820 per year, for the 2026‑27 academic year.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled in a taught or research master’s programme at a Scottish university for 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for eligible postgraduate master’s students, capped at £5,000 per year, with applications opening 1 May 2026.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Vacation Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income undergraduate students ordinarily resident in Scotland, in eligible year of study, not previously awarded a Vacation Scholarship.
opportunities.summary: Stipends based on the Scottish Living Wage to support summer research projects (4‑12 weeks) between mid‑May and August.
